description: This file is a shell script used for testing the disabling of SSH in git clone and fetch operations. It sets up test cases and verifies behaviors related to SSH handling.

methods.name: setup_ssh_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up a fake SSH wrapper for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates an initial commit in a repository.

methods.name: test_proto
methods.description: Tests specific protocols or URL schemes for SSH.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure.
